title: Speculative decoding: accept, reject and resample
summary: The min(1, p/q) acceptance rule and the residual distribution that keep speculative decoding exactly equal to the target model.

paper.title: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding

mutants.accept_ratio_inverted: Accepts with probability min(1, q / p), the draft over the target.
mutants.alpha_unweighted: Computes alpha as the mean over the vocabulary of min(1, p / q), not the sum of min(p, q).
mutants.expected_tokens_off_by_one: Uses alpha to the power gamma, not gamma + 1, so it forgets the bonus token.
mutants.no_bonus_token: Returns after full acceptance without the bonus token from the last target row.
mutants.residual_from_target: Samples from the target distribution after a rejection, not from the residual.
mutants.residual_not_clipped: Normalizes the absolute value of p - q in place of max(0, p - q).
